scope: Only unmodified local Qwen adapters on synthetic tensors; no model, GPU, benchmark predictions or labels.
finding: Both published local Qwen adapter pruners return spatially sorted original feature rows. A bitwise row identity map recovers their retained IDs without changing selection when each selected row has a unique full-image match; missing, repeated, ambiguous or unsorted rows fail closed.
caveat: Not an original-paper implementation claim; real model features, P3/three DS injection, wrapper identity and output still require a dedicated real-model smoke before any benchmark.
